notes: Best-structured calendar in the union: a dedicated events site with 231 events (title, dates, venue, city, keywords, registration) kept as a running archive, so 'what actually happened' and 'what is planned' are both visible. Office closures and a registration deadline were left out; recurring series (regional evangelism rallies, PBE/ABG levels, elders and church-ministries trainings, constituency pre-sessions) are listed once with counts. Two cancelled events (Oasis High School Retreat, Mobilize/Engage 2026) are kept with a CANCELLED note. Strong emphasis on lay evangelism equipping: 11 regional Evangelism Rallies (Sep 2025-Aug 2026, one in Spanish), LEADS Bible-study-leads training, Reach Your Neighbor evangelism retreat, ReCharge, prison ministries training, a day of fasting and prayer, the month-long 'Revelation Today: The Future Unfolding' Share Hope series across Greater Atlanta (Oct 2026) and Revive 2026 Collegedale. Also a full Pathfinder/Adventurer/Master Guide pipeline, many regional and language camp meetings (Collegedale, South Georgia, Upper Cumberland/Olde Time, Northeast Tennessee, Sabbath in the Smokies, Korean, Hispanic, Southern Deaf) and a large Hispanic department training track (elders, children's ministry, adult Sabbath School, men's and women's directors). The conference also lists a 2027 constituency session with five regional pre-sessions (Jan-Feb 2027).
